purpose: Teach: 光線/皇后/便秘/中越/河口/未婚/南下/右派

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、レーザー光線治療を医療チームで導入します
lines.en: Ren, we're introducing laser therapy across the medical team.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Professional but not cold. Slight emphasis on 'we'—inclusive. Steady eye contact. Even pacing, no rush.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、皇后陛下にもご紹介できる医療を医療チームで目指します
lines.en: Yes—we're aiming to provide healthcare here that would stand up to anyone's standards.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause after 'Yes'. Quiet conviction underneath. Matter-of-fact, not boastful. Shoulders set. Steady voice that carries weight without strain.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、便秘の食事指導を医療チームで提供します
lines.en: Ren, we also provide dietary guidance for constipation as part of comprehensive care.
lines.style: Professional, direct. No apology in the clinical detail. Warm underneath—caring about the small things that matter to patients. Steady, unhurried.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 中越地区の災害医療支援を、貴院、されてますね、先生
lines.en: I've noticed your hospital does disaster relief medical work in the Chuetsu region.
lines.style: Respectful, thoughtful inquiry. Slight lift at the end—genuine curiosity, not testing. Slower pace. Careful word choice showing he's been paying attention. A little tentative, but sincere.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、河口域の感染症対策を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Yes—we're researching infectious disease prevention in estuary communities as well.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Slight pause after 'Yes'. No inflation in the answer. Clear, honest. The voice of someone who sees these efforts as necessary work, not accomplishment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 未婚妊婦支援を、貴院、進められてますね、先生
lines.en: And you're actively supporting unmarried mothers too, I see.
lines.style: Careful respect. Aware he's asking about something tender. Not probing, observing. Quiet pace. Genuine acknowledgment underneath the formal structure.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、寒気が南下する季節の医療対応を医療チームで強化します
lines.en: Yes—we strengthen our medical protocols during the cold months when health needs shift.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, seasonal care as basic responsibility. No hesitation. Calm. The voice of someone thinking ahead, not reacting. Steady pacing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 政治的右派患者にも、貴院、平等に医療を提供されますね、先生
lines.en: And you treat patients across the political spectrum with equal care, don't you.
lines.style: Careful, measured statement. Not quite a question—more an observation offered with respect. Slower pace. Aware this matters. Slight warmth recognizing something difficult and right.
